ja: 添付を忘れてすみません。
alternatives: Sorry, I forgot to attach the file.
Sorry, I left out the attachment.
point: 特定の添付は the attachment

ja: メールより電話が早いよ。
en: A call is faster than email.
alternatives: It's faster to call than to email.
point: 比べる相手は than のあとに置く

en: Who should I send this to?
alternatives: Who do I send this to?
point: 前置詞 to は文末に残る

ja: 届いたらすぐ返信します。
en: I'll reply when I get it.
alternatives: I'll reply as soon as it arrives.
point: when 節は未来のことでも現在形

ja: 彼は明日送ると言った。
en: He said he'd send it tomorrow.
alternatives: He told me he'd send it tomorrow.
He said he was sending it tomorrow.
point: said のあとは will が would に変わる

ja: 日程確認でご連絡しました。
alternatives: I'm writing to confirm the date.
I'm emailing to confirm the date.
point: 目的は to + 動詞の原形で言える
